title: Approximate tangent planes of an integer multiplicity triple are n-dimensional μ_R-a.e.
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be any set and R = (M, θ, ξ) an integer multiplicity triple in U (Lean IMRep U n; M = R.carrier, θ = R.mult). Its weight is μ_R := R.measure = (Hⁿ⌞M).withDensity θ, where Hⁿ = μHE[n]. Then for μ_R-almost every x ∈ ℝ^P the subspace T_xM := approxTangentPlane n M x has dimension n: Module.finrank ℝ (approxTangentPlane n M x) = n. Here approxTangentPlane n M x is the chosen approximate tangent plane of M at x when one exists, and the zero subspace otherwise.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n), ∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, Module.finrank ℝ (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x) = n
